frostbyte_ops: Hey team — quick ask. We're kicking off an APAC demo next week and traffic will spike for ~48-72h. Can you temporarily raise the per-minute rate limit for their API key and add two IP ranges to the allowlist so traffic routes to the APAC edge? Renewal in 30d so we want the demo to go smooth.

Aisha (CSM): Thanks — can you paste expected RPS / burst and the CIDRs? Also which models/routes will they hit?

frostbyte_ops: Expected steady ~6 rps, short bursts to ~25 rps for 5-10s. Keys will call /v1/generate (gpt-4o-small) and embeddings route. CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.64/26. Prefer changes apply Thu 01:00 UTC for 72 hours.

Aisha (CSM): Noted. Marking as high priority given renewal window. @Leo please flag on account comms.

Leo (AE): Copy, will notify customer success execs and exec sponsor. Let's try to avoid a full Dedicated pool spin up if infra can handle burst via autoscaling.

Noah (Oncall): Quick questions: do we want a permanent allowlist entry or timebound? Also need exact API key id to scope the rate increase.

Sanjay (Infra): I can add timebound rate override for their API key and create an allowlist entry for the CIDRs on the edge LB. Two constraints: (1) APAC edge has token-based per-minute quotas — I need to confirm headroom for gpt-4o-small at 25 rps; (2) routing fallback may route to us-east if capacity fills, we should pin to APAC region for demo window.

Aisha (CSM): Customer asks to pin to APAC only for the window. They accept slightly higher latency vs routing fallback.

Sanjay (Infra): Ok. Proposed plan: create an allowlist entry scoped to their org + add a temporary rate policy: per_minute_limit=3000 tokens/min (approx matches 25 rps for their prompt sizes) and origin pin to apac-edge for 72h starting 1719075600 (Thu 01:00 UTC). I will also add a 5-minute rollback if error rate >5%.

Noah (Oncall): I'll add a monitor on 5xx rate and token queue length, with a pager if >5% errors sustained for 3 minutes. Also will add a dashboard panel for their key.

Sanjay (Infra): Config snippet I'm planning to apply (for ops trace):

```
allowlist {
  org: "frostbyte"
  cidrs: ["203.0.113.0/24", "198.51.100.64/26"]
  region: "apac-edge"
  expires_at: "1719268400"  # +72h
}
rate_override {
  api_key: "kb_XXXX"
  tokens_per_minute: 3000
  route_preference: ["apac-edge"]
  rollback_on_error_pct: 5
}
```

Aisha (CSM): Perfect. @Leo can you confirm the api_key id with FrostByte Ops and paste here?

Leo (AE): Will do, pinging them now.

frostbyte_ops: API key id is kb_7f3a9. Thanks for the quick turnaround. We'll send prod-like traffic Friday morning too.

Noah (Oncall): Got it. I'll stand by for the window and keep alerts enabled. 

deploy-bot: scheduled change: rate_override for kb_7f3a9 -> queued for 1719075600; allowlist entry queued for 1719075600.

Aisha (CSM): Closing loop: action items — Sanjay apply allowlist + rate override at Thu 01:00 UTC, Noah stand watch, Leo confirm customer comms. I'll follow up with notes for renewal exec. :thumbsup:
